parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of plastic, typically matching the seat in shape and size.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl to maintain hygiene, reduce odor, and provide a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small metallic component located on the top of the toilet tank, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structure of the toilet made of ceramic, supporting the seat, lid, and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability, houses the water passageways, and supports the user’s weight.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
